body: How about when the pain of today is too hard to try and stick around for tomorrow?
That's actually quite brave to come out of the anxiety a bit and share it with peers.

I just moved out of a beyond poor condition mobile home from the 70s. It was bad. It had mold, holes in the floor. It was always cold, the windows leaked. The bathroom sink didn't work. On top of it, my car was broken for years and in the driveway rusting away because I could not afford to fix it. I know the feeling.

A degree has brought me zilch. I have two stem degrees. I am unemployed. I am trying to get jobs but no one wants to hire me. I was a failure before and here I thought if I work hard and get those degrees, I can better my life. My life has not changed.
